title: Neuronavigated dual-target transcranial magnetic stimulation for schizophrenia negative symptoms
title_zh: 基于神经导航的双靶点经颅磁刺激对精神分裂症负面症状的疗效研究
abstract: Abstract Negative symptoms in schizophrenia severely impair function and quality of life, yet respond poorly to current therapies. This multicenter, randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial aimed to investigate the efficacy of neuronavigated dual-target repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) over the right dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (rDLPFC) and cerebellum for improving negative symptoms in early-stage psychosis (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT04853485). Participants with first-episode schizophrenia or clinical high-risk for psychosis were enrolled from Shanghai Mental Health Center and Suzhou Guangji Hospital. Participants were randomly assigned to either a real or sham group under MRI-guided neuronavigation, targeting rDLPFC with 1Hz at 100% motor threshold(MT), cerebellar with intermittent theta burst stimulation(iTBS) at 120% MT for 20 consecutive days. Clinical assessments were conducted at baseline(T0), 10-session(T1), 20-session(T2) and one month after the intervention(T3). Cognition and MRI were evaluated at T0 and T2. The primary outcome was change of negative subscale score of the Positive and Negative Symptoms Scale(PANSS), while secondary outcomes included alterations in other PANSS subscale scores and fronto-cerebellar circuit functional connectivity. In total, 75 participants were included in the intention-to-treat analysis (36 active, 39 sham). The pre-specified primary linear mixed-effects analysis revealed a non-significant group-by-time interaction for PANSS negative subscale scores (F(3,174.6)=1.45, p=0.230). At the 4-week endpoint (T2), the nominal unadjusted between-group p-value was 0.049; after Sidak correction for multiple comparisons, the adjusted mean difference was −2.48 points (95% CI −4.99 to 0.03, adjusted p=0.150, Cohen’s d=−0.51). Descriptive uncorrected t-tests indicated greater negative-symptom reductions in the active group at T1 and T2, and the 4-week negative-symptom response rate (≥50% reduction) was higher under real rTMS (χ2=9.5, p=0.002). A significant group-by-time interaction was observed for PANSS positive subscale scores (F(3,172.0)=3.26, p=0.023). Both groups exhibited substantial within-group symptom improvement. Resting-state fMRI demonstrated group-by-time interactions within cerebello-temporal, parahippocampal, caudate, and parietal networks (FWE-corrected p<0.05), and negative-symptom change correlated with cerebello-caudate connectivity (r=0.33, p=0.026). These findings suggest neuronavigated dual-target rTMS over rDLPFC and cerebellum may be associated with numerical improvements in negative symptoms in early-stage psychosis.
abstract_zh: 摘要：精神分裂症的负面症状严重损害功能和生活质量，但对现有治疗反应不佳。本多中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验旨在评估神经导航双靶点重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）对早期精神病患者负面症状的改善效果（ClinicalTrials.gov 识别号：NCT04853485）。招募的受试者为首次发作精神分裂症或临床高危精神病患者，来自上海精神卫生中心和苏州广济医院。受试者在MRI引导下随机分为真刺激组或安慰剂组，目标为右侧背外侧前额叶皮层（rDLPFC）以1 Hz、100 %运动阈值（MT）进行刺激，右侧小脑采用间歇性θ波束刺激（iTBS）120 % MT，连续20天。临床评估在基线（T0）、第10次刺激（T1）、第20次刺激（T2）以及干预后一个月（T3）进行。认知和MRI在T0和T2时评估。主要终点为正负症状量表（PANSS）负面子量表得分变化；次要终点包括其他PANSS子量表得分变化和额叶-小脑功能连接。总计75名受试者纳入意向治疗分析（活性组36人，安慰剂组39人）。预设的线性混合效应分析显示PANSS负面子量表得分的组×时间交互作用不显著（F(3,174.6)=1.45，p=0.230）。在4周终点（T2）时，未校正的组间p值为0.049；经Sidak多重比较校正后，校正均值差为-2.48分（95% CI -4.99至0.03，校正p=0.150，Cohen’s d=-0.51）。描述性未校正t检验显示活性组在T1和T2的负面症状减轻更大，4周负面症状响应率（≥50%减轻）在真rTMS组更高（χ²=9.5，p=0.002）。PANSS正面子量表得分出现显著组×时间交互作用（F(3,172.0)=3.26，p=0.023）。两组均表现出显著的组内症状改善。静息态fMRI显示在小脑-颞叶、旁海马、尾状核和顶叶网络内存在组×时间交互作用（FWE校正p<0.05），负面症状变化与小脑-尾状核连接相关（r=0.33，p=0.026）。这些结果表明，基于神经导航的双靶点rTMS（rDLPFC和小脑）可能与早期精神病负面症状的数值改善相关。
